senses.gloss: रुक्मिणी rukm-iṇ-ī, f. N. of a daughter of 🞄Bhīṣmaka, carried off and wedded by Kṛṣṇa, 🞄mother of Pradyumna, later identified 🞄with Lakṣmī.

रुक्मिन् rukm-ín, a. adorned with gold (V.);
 🞄m. N. of the eldest son of Bhīṣmaka and 🞄adversary of Kṛṣṇa.
रुक्ष्म rukṣma, incorr. for रूक्ष rūskha.

रूक्षय rūkṣa-ya, den. P. make thin;
 soil, 🞄sully. vi, besmear.
रूक्षीकृ rūkṣī-kṛ, make rough, soil, sully.
